title: Ukrainian Drones Overwhelm US Military in Combined Resolve Exercise
description:
During the Combined Resolve exercise in Germany, Ukrainian drone operators from the 412th Brigade effectively defeated U.S. troops, demonstrating significant advantages in drone warfare. The U.S. mechanized brigade, equipped with standard electronic warfare systems, was quickly overwhelmed, leading to the need for troops to be 're-spawned' to maintain the exercise. Reports indicate that an entire U.S. armored brigade was eliminated multiple times during the training, highlighting vulnerabilities in U.S. military drone capabilities. The exercise, which took place over two weeks in April and May 2026, involved 3,700 U.S. service members. U.S. officials acknowledged that the military is lagging in drone technology and tactics, prompting a push for improved training and adaptation. General Alexus Grynkewich emphasized the unique training value provided by Ukrainian forces, which cannot be replicated in the U.S. The event underscores the evolving nature of modern warfare and the critical role of drones.

Key Points:
• Ukrainian drone operators defeated U.S. troops during a military exercise in Germany.
• The exercise revealed significant vulnerabilities in U.S. military drone capabilities.
• U.S. forces are adapting their tactics in response to lessons learned from Ukrainian operations.
